# Customer Table

*Pages PDF 20-21*

## **Customer Table**
To work out who is currently patronising the tavern, roll 2d10. If the tavern is a Silver Tier location, add 5 to the roll. If it is a Gold Tier location, add 10 to the roll. Customers are Human unless noted otherwise. 

Taverns could be empty, or so full there is barely space to stand. It is up to the GM to decide how busy the venue is, but a sensible miminum would be to fill a quarter of the available space, whilst a sensible maximum would be to fill all the available space apart from somewhere for the Characters to sit.
